creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The mirror knows a pane's tab and workspace and nothing about where it
sits, so there is no tree for a window to render. This is the noun that
is missing.

`layout_updated` is the source: it carries a whole tab's layout in
absolute values, so applying it twice is applying it once, and it fires
on every pane event (observations/herdr-0.8.0.md). What it does not
fire for is tab and workspace events, so it must not become the only
structural signal.

The catch is that its rects live in herdr's own TUI coordinate space -
the recorded area is 54x23 at (26,1), herdr's window minus its sidebar.
Only structure and ratios mean anything to Muster; the cell numbers are
for reconstructing which node contains which, and nothing else. A tree
rebuilt that way is also how a divider is named back to the daemon,
since `layout.set_split_ratio` addresses one by a path of booleans.

Blocked on a_27RZE8ywI: a reconstruction checked against the one
recorded layout is a reconstruction checked against nothing.
title: 🧱 Layout in the vocabulary: a tab's tree, in Muster's words
